integrity: A self-contained finite order-type proof enumerates all 80 compatible linear extensions and 56 threshold-cut choices, independent of graph sizes; 4,884,036 direct labelled-state simulations give a separate finite check. Self-review are not independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform identical positive integer up/down thresholds, synchronous closed-neighborhood updates and simple complete bipartite graphs only; no claim for heterogeneous thresholds, arbitrary graphs or asynchronous schedules. No census of lower transient layers or full attractor basins. An unindexed historical equivalent is possible.
title: Sharp four-step relaxation and exact last-transient basins in bipartite bi-threshold dynamics
